source.check: Returning Officer's 'Notice that no poll will be taken' (J. A. Higgins, dated 21 October 1946), Mid-Ulster Mail 26 Oct 1946 p6, read in the page image: one candidate only for each of the listed divisions, to be declared elected. Names printed surname first.

note: Triennial election of Magherafelt rural district (26 divisions), Co. Londonderry polls postponed to 31 October 1946. Twenty-eight nominations were received on 17 October for twenty-six seats: Bellaghy and Magherafelt were contested and the other twenty-four divisions had one candidate each, declared elected without a poll (Returning Officer's notice, Mid-Ulster Mail, 26 October 1946, p. 6). The earlier record's seven new members carried a 'U.' label the paper did not print and two names misread from the OCR (Moore for Noone, Victor for George Victor Holmes); replaced from the notice (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). New member (Derry Journal, 18 October 1946, p. 7). Returned unopposed.
